newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Reynolds to sell stake in jv cable firm.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds to sell stake in jv cable firm.

text.p: Reynolds Philippines Corp said on Tuesday it was negotiating for the sale of its holdings in three joint venture firms with Malaysia's Leader Universal Holdings Bhd.
"There are very advanced negotiations for us to sell our interest in the joint ventures with Leader Universal," Reynolds' chief financial officer Jorge Navarra said.
"It's not going to take long," Navarra said when asked how long will it take to conclude the negotiations with the investor whom he declined to name.
Leader Reyphil Cable Corp, a 50-50 joint venture, manufactures aluminium wire cables and rods at its plant in the industrial Cavite province.
The two other firms, LR Philippine Realty Corp and LR Holdings Corp, own the lot where Leader Reyphil is located.
Aluminium maker Reynolds has been on the rise in recent days surging more than 75 percent to two pesos in four days.
